verdict.rationale: Digits documents its own agentic monitoring before the close. The Agentic Close runs quality control and surfaces exceptions before month-end, bookkeeping offers 24/7 AI transaction flagging, and the ledger deduplicates ingested entries. However, no documentation explicitly describes spend-anomaly detection or flagging existing duplicate transactions for review. Deduplication is automatic on ingest rather than flagged. missing for 10: explicit spend-anomaly detection docs, duplicate-transaction flagging (as opposed to silent dedup on ingest), details of what the quality checks cover, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor the ledger and flag anomalies in spend or duplicate transactions before the close
